## Scenario 1: Browse menubar exposes the Movies item

**Given** the user is on the Tubi home page
**When** the page has finished its initial `domcontentloaded` state
**Then** the main `<nav>` landmark is visible
**And** a `menuitem` with the name "Movies" is visible in the menubar

## Scenario 2: Movies page renders content tiles after lazy-load

**Given** the user is on the Tubi home page
**When** they click the Movies menubar item
**And** the lazy-loaded content is triggered (scroll to fire `IntersectionObserver`)
**Then** at least **12** content tiles (`data-testid="web-ui-content-tile"`) are rendered

## Scenario 3: Clicking a content tile opens a detail page

**Given** the user is on the Movies page
**When** they click the first content tile
**Then** the URL changes to match `/{some-slug}` (planner assumed slug-based detail routes)
**And** a play button is visible on the detail page

## Scenario 4: Browse menu dismisses on Escape key

**Given** the user has opened the Browse menubar dropdown
**When** they press the Escape key
**Then** the dropdown closes and focus returns to the Browse menuitem
